name: Improve Brain Daemons
description: Evidence-driven improvement of daemon control flow, crash recovery, lifecycle ceremonies, and code complexity.

steps.title: Gather evidence
steps.description: Read architect-prime project context for file locations. Read fleet agent brain logs for crashes (ReferenceError, TypeError, unhandled rejection), stuck loops (motor_dispatch stuck:true), and MAX_ITERATIONS hits. Query Firestore for failed/high-iteration missions. Run code checks: completion ceremony divergence (grep delivery_status assignments outside completeEnvelope), test coverage gaps, function complexity. Record findings with file:line references.
steps.accept_criteria: Ranked findings by severity (crash > stuck-loop > ceremony divergence > complexity). Each has file:line and frequency.

steps.title: Design and implement fixes
steps.description: For each finding: trace root cause to specific code path. Design fix stating which canon axis it improves (efficiency/structure/logic/cleanness) and confirming protected properties untouched (determinism/crash-safety/observability/testability). Implement the fix. Add regression test per crash/stuck-loop fix. Run all tests and node --check on changed files.
steps.accept_criteria: All tests pass. Each fix has canon axis claim. Each crash fix has regression test.

steps.title: Verify on live fleet
steps.description: Deploy to one agent. Send 3 test missions exercising the fixed paths. Read logs and telemetry. Confirm issues resolved, no new errors.
steps.accept_criteria: Fixed issues no longer occur. No regressions in logs or telemetry.
